Overview & City Profile

Orihuela (Orihuela (Provincia de Alicante)) is a municipality in Provincia de Alicante, Valencian Community (coordinates 38.0274°N, -0.9136°E; population 90,087). Visitors use Orihuela as a base to explore Valencian Community's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Authentic Paella Valenciana, Arroz a banda & Fideuà, Horchata de chufa with fartons.

Within Valencian Community Region (Provincia de Alicante region), Orihuela (Orihuela (Provincia de Alicante)) serves as a municipio (municipality) in valencian community region. Travelers exploring Valencian Community often combine a stop in Orihuela with regional highlights such as Valencia City of Arts and Sciences & Turia Gardens, Valencia Central Market & La Lonja de la Seda, Alicante Santa Bárbara Castle & Costa Blanca, Albufera Natural Park & Peñíscola.

Getting to Orihuela & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Valencia Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)): AVE / Ouigo / Iryo high-speed trains from Madrid to Valencia (1h50) and Alicante (2h15); Valencia (VLC) & Alicante (ALC) airports.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Valencian Community Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Valencia with Orihuela. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep €1,000 bills and €100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Valencian Community have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Orihuela en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Orihuela are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail station or airport in Valencian Community can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in Spain Guide.

Best Time to Visit & Seasonal Highlights

Best time to visit Valencian Community: Mar–Jun, Sep–Nov.

Regional highlights across Valencian Community Region that pair well with a visit to Orihuela include: Valencia City of Arts and Sciences & Turia Gardens, Valencia Central Market & La Lonja de la Seda, Alicante Santa Bárbara Castle & Costa Blanca, Albufera Natural Park & Peñíscola.

Practical Travel Tips for Orihuela

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Orihuela (or at Valencia Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Orihuela accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Spain Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Orihuela (Orihuela (Provincia de Alicante)) located in Spain?

Orihuela (Orihuela (Provincia de Alicante)) is a municipio (municipality) located in Valencian Community Region in the Provincia de Alicante region of Spain (coordinates: 38.0274°N, -0.9136°E). It has a population of approximately 90,087 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Orihuela by train?

Most visitors reach Orihuela via the main prefectural gateway of Valencia Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail). AVE / Ouigo / Iryo high-speed trains from Madrid to Valencia (1h50) and Alicante (2h15); Valencia (VLC) & Alicante (ALC) airports. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Orihuela. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare Calculator.

What local food is Orihuela and Valencian Community known for?

In Orihuela and across Valencian Community Region, top local dishes include Authentic Paella Valenciana, Arroz a banda & Fideuà, Horchata de chufa with fartons, as well as Turrón de Jijona and Valencian oranges. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Orihuela?

Best time to visit Valencian Community: Mar–Jun, Sep–Nov. Check our Spain Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
